Google Sheets — one backend for all modules

Copy the data now on screen into this Google Sheet

Before copying: open the WOP module and unlock it with the password (e.g. open the WOP Summary tab). Otherwise the internal cost figures are not loaded and cannot be copied.

Use this once, right after deploying the new script: whatever each module is showing now (loaded from its old connection or from this browser) is written to the new Sheet. Existing data in the new Sheet is replaced.

How to set up the Google Sheet
  1. Create a new Google Sheet, e.g. TTAMM Integrated Database.
  2. Open Extensions → Apps Script, delete the sample code and paste the unified Code.gs.
  3. Change ACCESS_PASSWORD at the top, then save.
  4. Deploy → New deployment → Web app. Execute as Me, Who has access Anyone. Authorise when asked.
  5. Copy the /exec URL, paste it above, press Test connection, then Copy … data, then Use this URL.
  6. To connect every user automatically, also paste the URL into HUB_SHEETS_URL near the top of this HTML file.
  7. Optional — one link for everyone: in the Apps Script editor add an HTML file named Index, paste this whole HTML file into it and deploy a new version. Opening the /exec URL then shows this app, already connected — nothing to host or share as a file.

🔑 ZNESB log in

Staff sign in with their company e-mail (👤 at the top). This password is the owner's emergency Admin key — remembered on this device until you log out.
